explication: Agent Sandbox is a Kubernetes sandbox orchestrator. Users submit Sandbox resources directly or through SDKs; the Kubernetes API stores them, controllers reconcile lifecycle and extension resources, and Pods run under an isolated sandbox runtime. Clients then access stable sandbox networking or in-pod process/file services, optionally through the router. The graph also preserves warm pools, claims, templates, snapshots, integrations, and observability. Some integration wiring is inferred only from documented capabilities and is shown as optional.
